definitions.explanation: A member of the police force responsible for maintaining public order, enforcing laws, and investigating crimes.

examples.japanese: {警察官|けいさつかん}を{呼|よ}んでください。
{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}ったので、{警察官|けいさつかん}に{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I got lost, so I asked a police officer.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{警察官|けいさつかん}になりたかった。
examples.english: He has wanted to become a police officer since he was a child.

examples.japanese: {警察官|けいさつかん}が{交差点|こうさてん}で{交通整理|こうつうせいり}をしている。
examples.english: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{交番|こうばん}に{警察官|けいさつかん}が{二人|ふたり}いたので、{財布|さいふ}を{落|お}としたことを{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: There were two police officers at the police box in front of the station, so I reported that I had lost my wallet.

notes:
{警察官|けいさつかん} is the formal term for police officer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察官|けいさつかん}になる (to become a police officer)
- {警察官|けいさつかん}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call the police)
- {女性|じょせい}{警察官|けいさつかん} (female police officer)

RELATED TERMS:
- {警官|けいかん} (police officer, slightly informal)
- {お巡りさん|おまわりさん} (police officer, casual/friendly)
- {刑事|けいじ} (detective)
- {婦警|ふけい} (policewoman, dated)
